parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas repiten lo mismo: puntuales, profesionales y minuciosos. Dory Anne DeMille quedó tan contenta que los contrató de forma mensual, y Charline Charite dice que en su negocio comercial dieron más valor del que pagó.
parrafo_2.en: The reviews keep saying the same thing: punctual, professional and thorough. Dory Anne DeMille was happy enough to book them on a monthly basis, and Charline Charite says their crew gave her commercial business more value than she paid for.

items.quote: When I booked my first cleaning with Clean & Simple Pro, I was a little nervous because that was the first time I was going to open my house to a cleaning company. After speaking with them, I knew I was in good hands.

It was a pleasure getting in touch with this company. They were booked to clean my commercial business and they were phenomenal! Very responsive, and professional. They had a lot of work to do and I was very impressed with the finished job. Definitely book with them, you get more than the value you pay for to be honest!

Was very happy with service. The cleaner they sent was punctual, personable, and did a very good job cleaning. Communication with the company has been excellent. Will be using them on a monthly basis.
